name: What is included in a full kitchen remodel versus a cosmetic update?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a full kitchen remodel versus a cosmetic update?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full kitchen remodel involves stripping the space down to the studs or subfloor to update the layout, mechanical systems, cabinetry, surfaces, and fixtures completely. Unlike a cosmetic refresh that only swaps cabinet doors or paint, a full remodel often involves moving plumbing lines, adding dedicated electrical circuits, and changing the floor plan. This comprehensive approach lets you correct traffic flow issues, replace worn subflooring, and bring older wiring up to modern building standards. While it requires a larger upfront investment and longer downtime, it resolves underlying structural or mechanical problems that surface updates cannot fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full kitchen remodel strips the room down to reconfigure layouts, plumbing, electrical, and cabinetry, whereas a cosmetic update only refreshes surfaces like paint and cabinet doors.
